notes: All prices are USD per million tokens (tool fees per 1,000 calls) from the providers' published list prices. Values derived from them are estimates, not invoices.

Service tiers: Request.ServiceTier accepts fast (OpenAI, Anthropic Opus), ultrafast (OpenAI), priority (Gemini) and flex (OpenAI, Gemini; priced like batch). Premium tiers cannot be combined with batch. Adapters map each provider's own field value onto these names.
Not priced: audio input; cache-storage fees; OpenAI regional (data-residency) uplift, because eligibility is per model and not machine-readable; Gemini Contributor tier.

Retired models and older families (for example Claude Opus 4/4.1, Sonnet 4, Haiku 3.5, OpenAI o1, o3-mini, GPT-4.x and gpt-5.2-pro (no official launch date), cyber and research-program models, Gemini 2.0 and Gemini 3.7 Flash (not on the pricing page)) are not included and come back unpriced.
effective_from is the launch date or the date of an announced price change, taken from the provider's release notes or changelog. A request dated before it is unpriced rather than guessed.
No tokenizer differences between model generations are published on the OpenAI or Google pricing pages; only Anthropic documents one (Claude 4.7 and later, about 30% more tokens for the same text).
